QuestionStmt.S: What is the molar mass of compound represented by following structure formula? (OH)

Solution.S:
For the given structure, molecular formula is $C_2H_6O$.

∴ Molar mass of the compound

$$= (\text{Mass of C} \times 2) + (\text{Mass of H} \times 6) + (\text{Mass of O} \times 1)$$

$$= (12 \times 2) + (1 \times 6) + (16 \times 1)$$

$$= 24 + 6 + 16$$

$$= 46 \, \text{g mol}^{-1}$$
